phase-stability-cab852e5.interpretation: Phase Stability: The algebraic requirement that a constant must commute with the energy generator.

initial-order-7be5ccf1.title: Initial Order
initial-order-7be5ccf1.interpretation: Initial Order: The requirement that the universe began in an extraordinarily special, low-entropy configuration.
initial-order-7be5ccf1.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

statistical-habitability-0a6e3188.title: Statistical Habitability
statistical-habitability-0a6e3188.interpretation: Statistical Habitability: The idea that we are simply the winners of a cosmic "lottery" of possible Big Bangs.
statistical-habitability-0a6e3188.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

sensitivity-rule-a0a9b5e6.title: Sensitivity Rule
sensitivity-rule-a0a9b5e6.interpretation: Sensitivity Rule: Why the Big Bang had to be exactly right for galaxies to form.
sensitivity-rule-a0a9b5e6.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

energy-decay-04600fd2.title: Energy Decay
energy-decay-04600fd2.interpretation: Energy Decay: The process where the star slows down as it loses energy to light and waves.
energy-decay-04600fd2.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

scalar-decay-11be6c2e.title: Scalar decay
scalar-decay-11be6c2e.interpretation: Scalar decay: The rule that voltage drops linearly with distance from a point charge.
scalar-decay-11be6c2e.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

unified-wave-3e179f6c.title: Unified Wave
unified-wave-3e179f6c.interpretation: Unified Wave: The single law that describes how both voltage and magnets travel through space.
unified-wave-3e179f6c.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

the-patch-rule-9210ab94.title: The Patch Rule
the-patch-rule-9210ab94.interpretation: The Patch Rule: The ability to always find a tiny region where gravity "turns off."
the-patch-rule-9210ab94.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

unity-of-motion-b7c51b2f.title: Unity of Motion
unity-of-motion-b7c51b2f.interpretation: Unity of Motion: The proof that you can't speed up in space without slowing down in time.
unity-of-motion-b7c51b2f.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

causal-wall-06ae3cc3.title: Causal Wall

causal-wall-06ae3cc3.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

the-crossover-2a4308d0.title: The Crossover

the-crossover-2a4308d0.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

the-terrell-angle-6ae02715.title: The Terrell Angle
the-terrell-angle-6ae02715.interpretation: The Terrell Angle: The degree to which a moving object appears to have turned relative to its actual orientation.
the-terrell-angle-6ae02715.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

operator-expansion-875bcc64.title: Operator Expansion
operator-expansion-875bcc64.interpretation: Operator Expansion: The representation of an observable as a weighted sum of its eigenstate projectors.
operator-expansion-875bcc64.limits_and_boundary: Great Expansion: Limiting case analysis pending.

indistinguishability-27d77c42.title: Indistinguishability
indistinguishability-27d77c42.interpretation: Indistinguishability: The fact that field excitations have no unique identity beyond their state properties.

structure-seed-99af7e9e.title: Structure Seed

rubin-aperture-law-1f61532b.title: Rubin Aperture Law

gauge-invariant-qed-lagrangian-8e095ae9.title: Gauge-Invariant Lagrangian (QED)
gauge-invariant-qed-lagrangian-8e095ae9.interpretation: The master Lagrangian density for Quantum Electrodynamics, describing the interaction between Dirac fermions and the electromagnetic gauge field.

gauge-invariant-qed-lagrangian-8e095ae9.limits_and_boundary: Correctly predicts the existence of light as a massless gauge boson required by the symmetry.

hamiltonian-vector-field-symplectic-9bc2.title: Hamiltonian Vector Field Identity
hamiltonian-vector-field-symplectic-9bc2.interpretation: Relates the dynamical flow velocity in phase space to the gradient of the energy functional through the interior product with the symplectic form.
hamiltonian-vector-field-symplectic-9bc2.symmetry_origin: The geometric derivation of Hamilton's equations from the extremization of the action integral.
hamiltonian-vector-field-symplectic-9bc2.limits_and_boundary: Defines the direction of motion as being everywhere tangent to surfaces of constant energy.

locally-invariant-kinetic-lagrangian-49b.title: Locally Invariant Kinetic Lagrangian
locally-invariant-kinetic-lagrangian-49b.interpretation: The gauge-invariant kinetic density for a fermion field, providing the master rule for the motion of matter in a gauge field.
locally-invariant-kinetic-lagrangian-49b.symmetry_origin: The geometric requirement for stationarity under the combined transformation of matter and gauge configurations.
locally-invariant-kinetic-lagrangian-49b.limits_and_boundary: Predicts the existence of currents and force-couplings as the direct consequences of local symmetry preservation.

qcd-quark-confinement-potential-05611821.title: Linear Confinement Potential
qcd-quark-confinement-potential-05611821.interpretation: Characterizes the potential energy between quarks, where the linear term $\sigma r$ ensures that the energy increases with separation.
qcd-quark-confinement-potential-05611821.symmetry_origin: The formation of color flux tubes in the non-Abelian vacuum.
qcd-quark-confinement-potential-05611821.limits_and_boundary: Explains the non-existence of isolated quarks (confinement) at macroscopic distances.

greens-function-defining-operator-ident-.title: Defining Equation for Green's Function
greens-function-defining-operator-ident-.interpretation: Defines the Green's function G as the impulse response of a linear differential operator L to a point source (delta function), representing the fundamental building block for general solutions.
greens-function-defining-operator-ident-.symmetry_origin: The linearity of the differential manifold and the principle of superposition.
greens-function-defining-operator-ident-.limits_and_boundary: Must satisfy the same homogeneous boundary conditions as the primary physical field to ensure a unique and well-posed solution.

phase-space-symplectic-two-form-e3d55310.title: Symplectic Two-Form and Phase Space Volume
phase-space-symplectic-two-form-e3d55310.interpretation: Establishes the non-degenerate, closed differential 2-form that defines the symplectic structure of phase space, preserving phase space volume under Hamiltonian flow.
phase-space-symplectic-two-form-e3d55310.symmetry_origin: Originates from the invariant bilinear form of symplectic group representations and coordinate-free formulation of Hamilton's variational principle.
phase-space-symplectic-two-form-e3d55310.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to standard Euclidean area forms under orthogonal projection and vanishes on Lagrangian submanifolds where coordinates or momenta are constrained.
